snippet.title: Chess Nuke - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The board is a battlefield. The rules are yours to break.

Chess Nuke is a high-synergy tactical roguelike where you don’t aim for a checkmate, you aim for total destruction.

You aren’t here to play a fair match. You're here to build a "CRAZY" engine of war, out-maneuver the enemy, and eventually annihilate the entire board. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4077580/Chess_Nuke/

Developer: Duwit
X: https://x.com/ChessNukeDuwit
